{{Quote|We will share pain. Like us, you will come to embrace it.|Sha'kel to Kaye Galfridian|<ref name="Invasion 2">[[Invasion 2|''Invasion'' 2]]</ref>}}
[[Commander/Legends|Commander]] '''Sha'kel''' was a [[Yuuzhan Vong]] warrior who commanded the [[slaveship]] [[Heart of Artorias|''Tsam P'ah'']]. His rank was marked by his red [[Vonduun Skerr Kyrric|armor]] and flesh extensions protruding from his upper jaw.

The Commander ordered the presence of [[Nina Galfridian]] for a meal in his throne room, but received her daughter [[Kaye Galfridian|Kaye]] instead. He stabbed her with a [[coufee]] to show her the Yuuzhan Vong way of embracing pain. He was beheaded by [[Arbeloa]] in a [[Revolt aboard the Tsam P'ah|revolt of slaves]] led by Kaye. Arbeloa turned his head into a hat that he wore.
